description: The generic reflective question pool, shared so the backend question engine and the mobile client (pre-threshold, day-1 questions) rotate over identical content. Every entry must be a question (end with '?') and must contain no advice language (the word 'should' never appears) — both platforms pin these invariants by test.
questions: What took up most space in your mind today?
What felt different today compared to yesterday?
When did you feel most like yourself today?
What's one small thing that went right today?
If today had a title, what would it be?
What are you carrying into tomorrow?
What did you notice today that you usually overlook?
